atoms.name: Normal equations
atoms.one_line: $X^\top Xw=X^\top y$; residual is orthogonal to columns.

atoms.name: Residual properties
atoms.one_line: With an intercept, $\sum e=0$, $\sum ex=0$ and the line passes through $(\bar x,\bar y)$.

atoms.name: Parameters and invertibility
atoms.one_line: $d+1$ weights; $X^\top X$ invertible iff $X$ has full column rank.

atoms.name: Rescaling and shifting
atoms.one_line: Scale $x$ by $c$: slope $\div c$. Shift $y$: intercept shifts.

atoms.name: More features
atoms.one_line: Training SSE never increases when a column is added.
